comment: Cue sheet for the 30-second opening: start second + spoken text (speakable spelling). Voice/speed are applied by scripts/revoice.py, so the picture never needs re-recording.

cues.text: Your AI remembers everything, and still books the wrong flight. You asked for Tokyo. It chose the overnight layover. Which memory did that?
Let AI remember. Keep every memory accountable. Nemotron replays the trip without each memory. Without memory one, Flight A disappears.
Remove one memory. Replay. See what changes. RecallGuard freezes the decision. Nemotron on Nebius replays it. You quarantine the culprit.
